jobs.description:
Client Services Representative


**Eco Performance Builders** is a well\-established and rapidly growing licensed general, HVAC, and insulation contractor dedicated to enhancing homes for optimal efficiency, comfort, and sustainability. With 14 years of industry experience, we take pride in making existing homes more energy\-efficient and comfortable.

  

We’re looking for an organized, proactive, and personable **Client Services Representative** to become a key part of our client experience and day\-to\-day operations.

  

This is first and foremost a **client service position**. You will often be the first person a prospective or existing client speaks with, so excellent communication, listening skills, professionalism, and attention to detail are essential. The right person will also be self\-directed, comfortable with technology, eager to learn, and interested in understanding the technical aspects of the work we do.

  

Key Responsibilities



Client Service \& Phone Communication


* Serve as the primary person answering our phones and one of the first points of contact for prospective and existing clients. You’ll listen carefully to understand prospective clients' needs, educate them about our services, answer initial questions, and help determine whether our company is a good fit for their project.
* This position involves both **incoming and outbound calls**, so you should enjoy speaking with people and be comfortable initiating conversations. Excellent phone etiquette, a friendly and professional speaking voice, strong listening skills, and attention to detail are important.


Scheduling \& Follow\-Up


* Schedule **sales visits and home walkthroughs** for prospective clients and help coordinate other appointments as needed.
* Follow up with clients at the completion of their projects to ensure they are satisfied and identify any outstanding items that need to be communicated to the appropriate team member.


Software, Systems \& Process Improvement


* You should be **tech\-savvy and eager to learn new software** as our company relies on a variety of software and digital tools to manage clients, projects, scheduling, and communication.
* We also value people who proactively identify opportunities to improve our systems and processes. If you see a way to better organize information, simplify a workflow, or improve how the company operates, we want you to speak up and help make it happen.


Special Projects \& Team Support


* From time to time, you may be asked to assist with projects outside of your normal day\-to\-day responsibilities. This could include supporting our sales and management teams with **larger RFP and bid submissions**, gathering and organizing documentation, preparing information, performing research, scheduling service and maintenance calls, project management, or helping with other company initiatives.
* You should be comfortable learning new tasks, taking ownership of assignments, and working independently when given a goal.


Learning Our Business


* We work in a technical industry involving **building science, home performance, HVAC, electrification, insulation, energy efficiency, and indoor air quality**.
* You don't need to arrive as a technical expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn. Over time, we expect you to develop enough understanding of our services to communicate effectively with clients and our technical staff.


Representing the Company


* You should be comfortable speaking with new people, communicating professionally over Zoom, and representing Eco Performance Builders at trade shows, job fairs, community events, and other public\-facing opportunities.


The Person We’re Looking For



The right person for this position is:


* **Organized and detail\-oriented** – You keep track of schedules, conversations, documentation, and follow\-ups without letting details fall through the cracks.
* **A strong communicator and listener** – You have excellent phone etiquette, a professional speaking voice, and communicate clearly and thoughtfully.
* **Proactive and self\-directed** – You don't need someone continually telling you what to do next. You can prioritize your work, stay productive, identify things that need attention, and work independently.
* **Tech\-savvy and eager to learn** – You're comfortable learning new software and interested in finding better ways to use technology and improve company processes.
* **Easygoing and patient** – You work well alongside different personalities and can remain professional and productive during stressful or challenging situations. You don't take personality differences or workplace frustrations personally and focus instead on working together to get the job done.
* **Punctual and dependable** – Your coworkers and our clients can count on you to show up on time and follow through on commitments.
* **A team player** – You're willing to pitch in, communicate openly, and help wherever needed.
* **Solution\-oriented and blame\-free** – When something goes wrong, you focus on solving the problem, learning from it, and moving forward rather than assigning blame or creating unnecessary drama.
* **Flexible** – You're comfortable adjusting when priorities, schedules, or circumstances change.
* **Curious and willing to learn** – You're interested in developing an understanding of building science and the technical aspects of our work.


What Success Looks Like


* A successful Client Services Representative is someone **our clients and our team can depend on**. Calls and follow\-ups happen when promised, sales visits are scheduled accurately, warranties are registered, information reaches the right people, and details don't get lost.
* Just as importantly, you take ownership of your role, continue learning, contribute to a positive and productive workplace, and look for opportunities to help the company operate more effectively.

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. The Innovation with Academia (IWA) Student Prototyping Program Manager serves as a program leader within the Defense Innovation Unit's Innovation with Academia program. IWA connects Department of War (DoW) mission problems with university talent, research, and expertise to develop pathways from problem discovery through prototyping, commercialization, transition, and ultimately capability the Department can use.  

The IWA Student Prototyping program utilizes experiential learning to inspire students to experience work in the National Security Industrial Base by matching highly talented undergraduate and graduate students to deliver rapid, early\-stage prototypes, whether technical or policy centered, that help solve the mission partner’s problem.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

  

**Date:** Sep 10, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30174**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


Supermicro Computer is looking for an Account Manager with selling technical solutions and developing business. The ideal candidate will develop under the guidance of a Sr. Sales leader by supporting enterprise\-level relationships.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


* This position will be responsible for sales account maintenance, provide technical and administrative product information, performs daily clerical and office maintenance tasks, such as typing correspondence, coordinating, data entry, quotations and process documents
* Monitor inventory, follow up ETA with purchasers and feedback to internal departments in a timely manner for any discrepancies
* Act as a liaison between sales, purchasing, production, procurement, and logistics departments
* Provide assistance for intra\-company project coordination between sales and non\-sales departments
* Enter, monitor, and communicate directly with clients regarding status of their orders, facilitating credit issues and negotiating returns
* Develop superior customer service relationships with prospects, compose report and send to clients on daily basis
* Provide backup support for the manager and team members
* Manage products through their entire lifecycle until product EOL
* Develop strategic sales goals with exceptional execution to meet the sales target
* Qualify leads and creating target lists of enterprise or data center accounts
* Seek potential customers (e.g., Corporate Customers, Value\-Added Resellers, OEMs) through cold calling and follow\-up customer visits
* Participate in marketing activities such as trade shows to generate leads
* Develop customer relationships and maintain/manage accounts, expand existing client accounts for retention and potential growth
* Work with cross functional teams to draft and negotiate various types of contracts
* Manage day\-to\-day sales operations
* Negotiate sales pricing, monitoring orders, facilitating credit issues and negotiating sales returns
**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor degree in business, engineering or similar fields preferred

• 1 year of hands\-on experience with selling computer hardware solutions to data center or enterprise accounts (prior software or telecom sales will be considered) preferred
  

• Successful track record with credible cold calling and follow\-up with key decision makers
  

• Ability to thrive both independently and in a team environment
  

• Demonstrated ability in the following areas: pre\-call planning, opportunity qualification and objection handling, call structure and control, time and territory management
  

• Strong persuasive and negotiating skills; Ability to polished words in verbal, written, and presentation
  

• Extremely proactive, highly organized, with proven ability to manage multiple tasks
  

• Exceptional management skill in time and territory
**Salary Range**
----------------


$72,500 \- $104,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.


**EEO Statement**
-----------------


Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

**About Face Reality:**  

Face Reality Skincare was created with one goal: to give people clear skin for good. With over 50 million people experiencing the physical and emotional toll of acne each year in the US, we made it our mission to develop an effective way to achieve clear skin through our clinically verified Clear Skin MethodTM, an adaptive method combining in\-clinic treatments from certified skincare professionals, personalized at home product routines and lifestyle guidance. We are dedicated to giving not just real results but celebrating people and their skin at every part of their journey. **Our Core Values** **Integrity, Inclusion, Collaboration, Adaptability, Accessibility**  

Our supportive business model ensures that everyone has a clear path to success and growth. We foster an inclusive space in which people are valued for who they are and are encouraged to collaborate to see goals fully realized. Fostering an open, honest culture gives us the opportunity to achieve greater trust internally and externally. Remaining flexible and adaptive allows us to remain responsive to the ever\-changing world. Doing right, even if it is difficult, is of the utmost importance. **About the role**  

We are seeking an experienced and driven Associate Account Manager to join our team. This position reports directly to the National Sales Manager. ***\*Please note that this is a hybrid position working out of our corporate office in San Ramon CA every Tuesday \- Thursday and working remotely Mondays and Fridays and since this is supporting our Central Territory it would be CST Hours working from approximately 7am\-3pm.*** **RESPONSIBILITIES/ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** **Client Relationship Management:**

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Enterprise Customer Success Manager**
---------------------------------------

**San Francisco on\-site preferred; remote is acceptable · Full\-time**


Base salary: $70,000–$100,000 USD annually. Equity: 0\.05–0\.1%. Includes performance\-based commission designed to strongly reward results. Visa sponsorship is not available.

**Build lasting customer value**
--------------------------------


Enterprise AI creates value when it becomes part of everyday operations. Launch is only the beginning. You will own adoption, value realization, relationship health, renewal readiness, and expansion after go\-live, combining commercial accountability with technical fluency.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Build success plans around measurable operational outcomes and maintain strong executive and working relationships.
* Drive adoption, lead evidence\-based business reviews, and make customer value visible.
* Identify renewal risks early and coordinate recovery with Forward Deployment, Product, Engineering, and the founders.
* Find expansion opportunities grounded in customer needs and demonstrated value.
* Turn successful approaches into reusable account playbooks and customer feedback into product improvements.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Enterprise customer success, technical account management, or consulting experience with evidence of improved adoption, retention, or expansion.
* Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, and enterprise workflows.
* Clear executive communication, commercial judgment, and consistent follow\-through.
* The ability to build the first useful process while staying close to customers.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


Customers can explain the value they receive. Risks are visible early, renewals are earned, and expansion follows from useful outcomes. You will partner with Forward Deployment on implementation and the founders on commercial negotiations.

**About Sainapse**

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.  

  

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight\-powered solutions at scale.

jobs.title: Project Manager (SaaS Implementations)
jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed \& Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.


Bullhorn is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.


**About the role**

The **Project Manager** is a key position within Professional Services and the PMO and acts with integrity and leads by example, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role is accountable for ensuring the right resources, governance, and methodologies are in place to enable successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex core SaaS system implementations for our clients, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, on budget, and with high CSAT scores.


In this capacity, the Project Manager partners closely with Customers, Sales Executives, Solution Consultants, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and deliverables align with defined success criteria. By applying project management best practices and adhering to Bullhorn’s PMO processes, the Senior Project Manager defines, drives, and manages the delivery of projects, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through closure.  

  



**A typical day will include...**
---------------------------------

* **Owning the Project Lifecycle:** Lead the planning, execution, and closure of multiple, concurrent, large\-scale client software implementation projects, establishing the necessary governance and structure where none exists.
* **Proactively Drive Clarity and Order:** Quickly assess and gain command over complex, ambiguous, and high\-risk projects, translating chaos into defined, manageable, and executable project plans.
* **Ultimate Accountability:** Serve as the single point of accountability for project status and success. Naturally take ownership of problems and aggressively drive solutions to resolution.
* **Rigorous Risk and Scope Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and issues. Firmly manage scope creep and hold both internal and client stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Executive\-Level Communicatio** n: Manage client and vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for project status, expectations, and issue resolution with executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* **Financial and Resource Control:** Oversee project budgets, tracking hours and expenses to ensure financial targets are met and providing accurate, predictable and insightful forecasting and reporting.
* **Methodology Adherence:** Apply project management best practices and actively contribute to the development, improvement and standardization of Bullhorn's PMO processes.
* Mentoring and provide guidance to junior project managers or implementation specialists on best practices and project governance.

**This role is a fit for you if...**
------------------------------------

* Have 3\+ years of progressive experience managing complex, external client\-facing software implementation projects, with a significant focus on ERP, HCM, CRM, or large\-scale SaaS solutions with billable utilization targets.
* A proven track record of successfully delivering projects that have a high level of complexity and ambiguity, demonstrating the ability to rapidly impose structure and governance.
* An expertise in defining and managing project scope, schedules, and budgets for large enterprise clients.
* A mastery of various project management methodologies ( *e.g.,* Waterfall, Scrum, Hybrid) and knowing when to apply each to achieve stability.
* A solid understanding of the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, integration, testing (UAT), and go\-live.
* Have a proficiency with modern project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, SmartSheet) and resource management systems.
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent is highly preferred.

The annual base salary range for this position is $92,002 \- $115,000\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus \& a comprehensive benefits package.


**Compensation and Transparency Statement**

The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request

Our multi\-brand and omni\-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

**Job Summary:**

 **PetPartners Inc.** is seeking a **Customer Onboarding Specialist\- Associate** who will report to the Manager, Operations Business Processes. The Customer Onboarding Specialist\- Associate is responsible for ensuring a seamless onboarding experience for new and renewing group insurance clients, driving operational excellence and client satisfaction across all lines of business. This individual will serve as a cross\-functional liaison between clients, technology partners, producers, and internal stakeholders to manage the end\-to\-end onboarding and implementation process for group pet insurance and employer\-sponsored offerings.

* Excellent communication and strong time management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex onboarding projects.

jobs.title: Contact Center - Customer Service Representative, Contact Center
jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
Wellcove has been recognized as the nation’s leading full\-service senior market solutions provider for over 25 years. Our solutions span the insurance senior market sector, focusing on long\-term care and Medicare Supplement plans. However, we don’t stop there. Wellcove also addresses challenges faced in accident \& health, disability, and supplemental health insurance programs.
  
  

Our team provides individuals and their families with peace of mind knowing their insurance needs will be met in a thoughtful, efficient manner. We are able to do this because of our dedicated associates, innovative solutions, and state\-of\-the\-art technology.
  
  

Job Summary
  
This job provides customer service in a call center environment by primarily receiving and responding to telephone inquiries from policyholders, beneficiaries, providers, agents, or others for information concerning insurance policies by performing the following duties.
  
  

**Duties/Responsibilities:**  

* Provides information and assistance to providers, agents, policyholders, and others by responding to telephone inquiries from CHCS third third\-party administrator clients to include Medicare Supplement and Life Policies.
* Accurately provide information regarding various insurance questions (i.e., verification of benefits, claims status) by accessing and updating software system data within company response standards.
* Provides service and follow\-up on insurance questions by researching company records to obtain information requested by customer, performing routine transactions, and retrieving results from an online terminal.
* Maintains working knowledge base of all company products and services.
* Complying with company regulations regarding Privacy, confidentiality, and private health information.
* Providing written and oral communication to policyholders, agents, providers, and others regarding inquiry status and resolution.
* Initiate and complete Call Tracks, checklists, and supportive clerical responsibilities as necessary.
* Ability and Flexibility to work various shifts as required.
* Able to type speed of 30 wpm with 95% accuracy rate.


**Standard Company Requirements:**  

* Collaborative team spirit.
* Accountable and able to work remotely and independently.
* Able to pass background screening and drug tests pre and post hire – includes THC
* Verification of high school, GED, or college diploma upon request.
* Timely responses from three professional references.
* Able to provide a dedicated remote work location free from background noises, interruptions, and desk clutter.
* Able to provide an ongoing reliable internet connection and access to a smart phone for Multi Factor Authentication and communication purposes.


**Education and Experience:**  

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); and six months related call center experience and/or training.
  
Preferred Experience
  
* Associate’s degree
* Experience with Long Term Care Insurance preferable in a Call Center setting
* 2 years related call center and customer service experience

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The associate must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. The associate must be able to present and speak simultaneously in meetings.
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer and phone line usage.
* Ability to read, hear, speak, use keyboard, reason and problem solve.
* Requires the use of office equipment such as computer terminals, telephones, or copiers.
* Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: preparing and analyzing data, transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, extensive reading.


**Required Skills/Abilities:**  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duties satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
* Accurately entering data via Windows\-based environment
* Intermediate computer skills
* Knowledge use of basic math and English spelling and grammar skills
* Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence. Ability to effectively present information in one\-on\-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.
* Customer Service, Integrity/Honesty, Oral Communications, Motivation, Organizational/Planning/Organizing
* Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
* Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

jobs.description:

**Customer Escalation Specialist**


Work Hours: 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM CST

  

The Customer Escalation Specialist is responsible for managing and resolving escalated customer order issues to ensure a timely and satisfactory resolution.

  

The Customer Escalation Specialist investigates individual cases, coordinates with internal teams to resolve issues, and communicates clearly with customers regarding status and resolution. This position requires strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm and professional when handling urgent or sensitive customer situations.

* + In\-House order delays
	+ Orders lost in transit
	+ Orders with no tracking movement
	+ Service replacement orders
	+ Order changes or cancellations
	+ Customer concerns via phone or internal teams

* Ability to interact with a multi\-disciplinary team to assist in facets of the recovery program relating to physical health.
* Knowledge of the 12\-Step Recovery Program.

* Knowledge of alcohol and other drugs that includes;

Adults

* Conduct initial telephone screening of potential clients and referents to ensure that clients meet admission criteria.

jobs.title: Account Manager – Targeted Accounts (Houston)
jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

***The territory encompasses Houston TX, College Station, Corpus Christi and Rio Grande Valley. Experience calling on MD Anderson Cancer Center is a plus.***

**General Description:**


Reporting to the Division Sales Manager – Targeted Accounts, the Account Manager – Targeted Accounts, will contribute to BeOne’s overall sales objectives by performing assigned sales activities. The Account Manager – Targeted Accounts will provide physicians, pharmacists, and healthcare professionals with products, services, and information that will enable them to prescribe BeOne’s portfolio of products safely and effectively. The Account Manager – Targeted Accounts will focus on strategic initiatives in high performing accounts to support the Hematology and Solid Tumor franchises (Hematology in the near term). The ideal candidate will be capable of managing territory and administrative requirements in an efficient manner and will achieve full compliance with drug laws and regulations when representing BeOne’s products to health care providers. The ideal candidate should also demonstrate strength in the competencies of teamwork, entrepreneurial mindset, and driving for results.

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Promotes BeOne’s Hematology and Solid Tumor (Hematology in the near term) products through calls on targeted physicians in the assigned territory. Will implement sales, marketing, and patient support programs to acquire and keep appropriate patients on BeOne Hematology and Solid Tumor products.
* Trains and educates physician support staff on the proper use and handling of BeOne’s Hematology and Solid Tumor products.
* Ensures that healthcare professionals have realistic expectations concerning the use of BeOne's Hematology and Solid Tumor products with their patients.
* Maintains communication and integrates activities, when appropriate, with BeOne’s Market Access and Customer Enterprise teams. Will collaborate with Field Medical when appropriate.
* Identifies customer prescribing trends and territory dynamics and ensures, through coordinated communication and planning, that appropriate people and resources are allocated to opportunities.
* Successful completion of all clinical training, sales training and eLMS/Compliance Wire assignments.
* Performs all administrative functions required of the position, including reporting call activity and entering customer / account information in the appropriate call reporting system in a timely manner, as well as submitting expenses and utilizing the corporate credit card.
* Is compliant with applicable BeOne policies and procedures (e.g., healthcare compliance policy, adverse event reporting, travel and expense reporting).
* Assists in the identification and resolution of opportunities and challenges; communicates insights proactively to marketing and sales leadership.
* Must be skilled in working in fast paced environments with shifting priorities.

**Required Experience:**

* This position requires a B.A. / B.S. with previous pharmaceutical sales experience preferred.
* The ideal candidate should have 8 plus years’ experience in pharmaceutical sales \& sales management, with significant oncology experience.
* Must have a self\-starting, self\-managing independent work style.
* Dedicated to making customer service a priority.
* Must be results oriented with a strategic focus on sales.
* Experience in specialty sales, with an understanding of reimbursement, distribution, and managed care processes as well as an understanding of national/corporate accounts, managed markets, hospital markets, sites of care, IV medications, injectables, orals, Medicare Part D, etc.
* Ability to measure and analyze key performance indicators (ROI and KPIs).
* Familiarity with CRM software and proven track record of use.
* Ability to actively engage in developing new business.
* Proven track record of resilience in the face of challenges

 **Supervisory Responsibilities:** N/A

jobs.title: Project Manager - UX Research Vendor Operations
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to support a high volume UX Research organization. This individual will own a portfolio of vendor engagements from initial intake through contract execution, purchase order issuance, and invoicing.



This is an ownership role rather than a traditional project support position. You will be accountable for keeping every engagement moving, proactively following up with stakeholders, identifying and resolving blockers, and communicating progress before being asked.



The team supports more than **700 UX Research projects annually**, creating an opportunity to work across a broad portfolio of high value research initiatives while gaining early visibility into products and experiences being developed across the organization. You will join a collaborative and welcoming team where your ability to make an immediate impact is valued.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Serve as the primary point of contact and guide for UX Researchers navigating vendor and procurement processes
* Own UX Research vendor engagements from intake through SOW creation and execution, PO issuance, and invoicing
* Manage a portfolio of active engagements and ensure each case continues progressing toward completion
* Coordinate across researchers, contract associates, vendors, approvers, and leadership
* Proactively follow up with stakeholders and create urgency when actions or approvals are outstanding
* Identify blockers quickly, recommend solutions, escalate appropriately, and drive issues through resolution
* Provide proactive written updates to managers and stakeholders covering progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers
* Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential issues before they delay an engagement
* Maintain accurate KPI and SLA tracking and ensure strong data integrity
* Maintain vendor resources, process documentation, team wikis, and toolkits
* Identify recurring friction within the intake to contract process and recommend process improvements
* Manage projects associated with implementing process improvements
* Provide guidance regarding compliance policies associated with vendor engagements

### **What Success Looks Like**



Success in this role requires a strong sense of ownership and urgency. You take action rather than waiting for direction, keep your commitments moving, and close the loop on outstanding items. Your manager and stakeholders know the status of your work because you communicate proactively, not because they need to ask.



You are comfortable operating independently in ambiguity, know when to escalate, and remain persistent when progress depends on someone else. Just as importantly, you bring empathy to the process and help internal stakeholders and external vendors navigate complex systems and competing priorities.


### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree
* 4 or more years of experience in project coordination, project management, program management, procurement, vendor management, or operations
* Demonstrated experience independently owning workstreams from beginning through completion
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects or cases across cross functional teams and external partners
* Strong ability to maintain momentum across a high volume portfolio with minimal day to day supervision
* Experience proactively communicating status, risks, and blockers through regular written updates
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools to increase productivity, efficiency, and overall throughput
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adapt communication for peers, cross functional stakeholders, and senior leadership
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions in ambiguous situations
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, prioritization, and follow through

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in procurement, sourcing, contracting, or vendor management
* Experience supporting research, R\&D, UX, or creative organizations
* Project or program management training or certification such as PMP or CAPM
* Experience with case management, ticketing, or workflow management systems
* Familiarity with UX Research or Research Operations

These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness, meet client expectations, standards, and accompanying requirements, and safeguard business operations and company reputation.

jobs.title: Community Support Manager
jobs.description:
Bellese is a mission\-driven Digital Services Company committed to pioneering innovative technology solutions in civic healthcare. Our dedication lies in making a meaningful impact on public health outcomes.

Driven by service design, we strive to know the “Why” to understand the healthcare journey for patients, caregivers, providers, payers, and policymakers. Our goal is to design and build solutions that reduce confusion, provide clarity, support decision making, and streamline the process so that we and our partners can focus on providing better health outcomes by improving patient care and reducing costs and burden. ***The Team you will be joining: HQR***



Our team is charged with maintaining and improving the software at the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) that supports the Hospital Quality Reporting program. Thousands of hospitals across the country depend on these systems to submit quality measure data that reflects the care beneficiaries receive in their facility. Our teams will continuously strive to modernize these systems, while improving them in ways that reduce provider burden and minimize costs to CMS. We do this through HCD and Service design practices, product thinking, and skilled engineering. At Bellese, we’re relentlessly focused on enabling and empowering providers to focus on improving the quality and safety of patient care.

  


***Role Overview***  

The Community Support Manager will lead operational communications and support activities for the Claims team within the HQR contract. This role will provide a point of ownership for partner communications, shared inbox management, ServiceNow support, issue coordination, and other recurring interactions between the Claims team and internal and external stakeholders.  

  

The Community Support Manager will work closely with Product, Engineering, program leadership, CMS stakeholders, contractors, and support organizations to ensure inquiries are routed appropriately, issues are tracked through resolution, commitments are communicated clearly, and recurring support needs are incorporated into team planning.  

  

***Key Responsibilities:***  

Partner and Stakeholder Communications

* Serve as a consistent point of contact for operational questions, requests, deliverables, and follow\-up activities.
* Coordinate responses across Product, Engineering, and subject matter experts when requests require technical or policy input.
* Track partner requests, commitments, decisions, and outstanding actions through completion.
* Support communications related to Claims deliverables.


Team Inbox Management  

* Own day\-to\-day management of Claims shared mailboxes and other centralized communication channels.
* Review, categorize, prioritize, and route incoming requests to the appropriate team members.
* Establish clear service expectations for acknowledgment, response, escalation, and closure.
* Maintain visibility into outstanding requests and follow up with owners when responses or actions are due.
* Identify recurring questions and opportunities to reduce inbound support through improved documentation or standardized communications.


ServiceNow and Support Operations  

* Support Claims ServiceNow intake, triage, tracking, and follow\-up.

* Support recurring Claims operational meetings by preparing status information, documenting decisions, and tracking follow\-up actions.
* Partner with Product leadership to ensure significant support trends and stakeholder feedback inform backlog prioritization and planning.
* Coordinate operational activities associated with recurring deliverables, reporting cycles, and external dependencies.

* Maintain documentation for recurring Claims support processes and ensure information remains current.
* Identify recurring manual processes, communication gaps, and unclear ownership and recommend improvements.
* Help establish measurable service standards for Claims support activities.
* Support knowledge transfer and continuity when responsibilities or team members change.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex issues into clear status updates and action items.
* Experience managing shared inboxes, ticketing systems, service desks, or comparable request\-management workflows.
* Strong organizational skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, deadlines, and dependencies.

Pendulum is on a mission to help people improve physical and mental health by creating a new category of products that target the microbiome. We are researching, developing and commercializing a novel class of rationally\-designed Live Synbiotics (probiotics \+ prebiotics) that have demonstrated utility in addressing conditions like metabolic syndrome, inflammation and neurodegeneration.



Pendulum has created a unique discovery platform that utilizes genome sequencing and advanced computational approaches to identify novel, proprietary bacterial strains that augment key functions within the gut microbiome relevant to the respective disease state.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager

**About MonetizeMore**
----------------------


MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture\-first organization driven by four core values: **Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen** (Continuous Improvement), and **Collaboration**. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

  

**About the Role**
------------------


The company is seeking an experienced, systems\-driven **Business Operations Manager** to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end\-to\-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.

About Clutch Affiliate

Clutch Affiliate is a women\-owned affiliate and partnership marketing agency working with CPG and DTC brands across Amazon, DTC/network affiliate, publisher affiliate, TikTok Shop, and PR affiliate. With remote offices in Tampa, Florida and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, we run lean and move fast, both with our clients and with each other. If you like clear ownership over your work and don't want corporate red tape, you'll fit in here.

The Role

We're looking for a Project Manager / Admin who can be the connective tissue across Clutch. This role oversees the moving pieces across our full client roster and supports our co\-founders directly, keeping projects, deadlines, and next steps on track internally and with clients. You'll need to be organized, proactive, and comfortable owning the details other people forget to track.

This is not primarily an affiliate marketing execution role. Affiliate marketing knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement, we're happy to train that piece. What matters most is that you're a sharp project manager and administrator who can keep multiple clients and workstreams moving without being told twice.

We're not currently tied to a specific project management platform. If you have strong experience with a PM tool you love (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Notion, or otherwise) and think it would serve us well, we're genuinely open to adopting it.

If it's a mutual fit, there's real room to grow into full\-time as our client base expands.

What You'll Do

\- Serve as the central point of organization across all client accounts, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and next steps

\- Provide direct administrative support to Clutch's co\-founders, managing schedules, priorities, and follow\-through

\- Keep internal projects on track, flagging what's falling behind before it becomes a problem

\- Coordinate across the team to make sure client needs are being met on time

\- Build and maintain systems (trackers, checklists, calendars) that keep the agency organized as it scales

\- Sit in on client calls as needed to capture next steps and keep projects moving

\- Support affiliate program operations where needed (we'll train you on this as it comes up)

\- Bring ideas to the table on how to make Clutch run more efficiently, not just execute on someone else's

What You Need

\- Strong project management skills, comfortable juggling multiple clients and priorities at once

\- Excellent organizational skills and follow\-through, nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

\- Comfortable providing high\-level administrative support to founders

\- Self\-starter energy. We're not going to micromanage you; we need someone who sees what needs doing and does it

\- Clear, confident communicator, both internally and with clients

\- Genuine interest in helping a small agency run well and grow

Nice to Have

\- Familiarity with affiliate/publisher marketing (CJ, Avantlink, AWIN, or Impact)

\- PR affiliate experience

\- Experience with a PM platform you'd advocate for us adopting

Hours and Structure

Flexible and remote. Potential to expand to full\-time based on performance and agency growth.

Pay

Hourly, based on experience.

To Apply

To help us see who reads instructions carefully, please include the following when you apply:

1\. In your cover letter or application message, name one podcast episode Clutch Affiliate has appeared on (you'll find this on our website at www.clutchaffiliate.com).

2\. Include the phrase "Growth Partner" somewhere in your subject line or application message.

Applications that skip these steps will not be considered.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross\-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.


Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management's strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

**Responsibilities**


Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

* **Project \& Timeline Management:** Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.
* **Product \& Cross‑Functional Leadership:** Partner closely with Product Managers, Marketing, R\&D, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and Creative at both working and leadership levels. Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
* **Advanced Risk Management:** Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
* Typically 7–10\+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

**Management Skills**

* **Detail‑Oriented:** Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
* **Communication:** Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
* **Problem‑Solving:** Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
* **Cross‑Functional Fluency:** Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
* **Adaptability \& Ambiguity:** Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Mediator, not Participant:** Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.
* **Conflict Navigation:** Navigates complex, high‑stakes conflicts across teams and leadership levels with sound judgment. Resolves competing priorities constructively, escalating appropriately to protect project outcomes.
* **Calm in the Storm:** Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.
* **Attention to Detail:** Continuously monitors program health at both project and portfolio levels, ensuring small gaps or inconsistencies are identified early and do not scale into larger delivery or quality issues.

jobs.title: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Reporting & Compliance Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Built by enterprise software engineers and compliance experts, we provide comprehensive Affordable Care Act (ACA) reporting and compliance services. Our team of seasoned ACA specialists, data integration experts, in\-house legal counsel, and accounting professionals delivers accurate, efficient, and trustworthy service to every client.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Manager to lead the process behind our ACA compliance deliverables. This role does not focus on finding or fixing every error directly \- rather, it focuses on catching the exceptions: patterns, inconsistencies, and edge cases that indicate a deliverable isn't ready for client review.

As the QA Manager, you will oversee the review of completed ACA Forms 1094\-C and 1095\-C work prepared by our analyst team, verify that coding and documentation meet internal standards, and ensure every deliverable is accurate, defensible, and audit\-ready before it reaches the client. This role requires technical knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements, and sharp pattern\-recognition skills.

If you enjoy digging into data to find the exception that everyone else missed, thrive under deadline pressure, and take pride in building a team that delivers accurate ACA reporting and compliance work, we look forward to hearing from you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review completed ACA reporting deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to client delivery
* Verify Line 14, 15, and 16 coding against plan details, employee eligibility, classification, enrollment, and affordability requirements
* Identify coding inconsistencies between current and prior filing years, and confirm that any changes are properly explained
* Run and review error reports to catch missing data, incorrect codes, or discrepancies between source files and final output
* Cross\-check questionnaire responses against how each case was actually coded and processed
* Verify that every enrolled individual is accounted for, appropriately documented, and matched with a corresponding form
* Spot\-check high\-risk scenarios, including mid\-year terminations, rehires, status changes, and multi\-FEIN employers
* Ensure findings, exceptions, and assumptions are clearly documented in tickets and supporting files
* Maintain consistent file naming, folder structure, and documentation standards across the QA process
* Provide feedback to analysts to improve accuracy and reduce recurring errors
* Collaborate with account managers and analysts to resolve open questions before deliverables are finalized

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excel Proficiency: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, INDEX / MATCH, Pivot Tables, Nested IF statements, Logical / Array formulas
* Minimum of two years hands\-on experience preparing Forms 1094 and 1095 C\-series. B series and/or ICHRA experience is a plus
* Working knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements under IRC §6055 and §6056
* Strong understanding of Line 14/15/16 coding logic, safe harbor determinations, and affordability analysis
* High attention to detail and the ability to identify patterns or anomalies across large, multi\-source datasets
* Strong written communication skills for documenting findings, exceptions, and client\-facing notes
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, remote environment

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience leading, training, or mentoring
* Experience with quality assurance, audit, or error\-report review processes
* Exposure to HRIS/payroll data sources (e.g., ADP, Paylocity, UKG, Employee Navigator)
* Prior experience in a client\-facing or project coordination role
* Familiarity with Excel add\-ins such as Power Query that streamline data cleanup and processing.

**Interview Process**

As a remote team, we require applicants to demonstrate their ability to work independently via an Excel\-based **Technical Abilities Assessment**.

If your qualifications and experience are a match, you will receive an invitation to schedule the day and time of assessment. A packet including detailed instructions for processing and submission will then be sent for completion within 90 minutes or less.

**Why Join Us?**

* A clear path for growth, salary increases, and seasonal bonuses based on performance
* Hands\-on leadership role shaping the quality and accuracy of every client deliverable
* Work with a supportive, collaborative team of ACA specialists, data experts, and compliance professionals

jobs.title: Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross\-referencing, and stress\-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.


The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.


They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI\-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.


In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

**CFWA Relationship Management — CVS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day\-to\-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.
* Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.
* Lead recurring CFWA governance touchpoints (e.g., joint operating and workgroup meetings), setting agendas, tracking action items, and driving issues to closure.
* Review CVS\-provided FWA reporting, investigative summaries, audit results, and recovery activity for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with source claims data; challenge findings that are not supported by the data.
* Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.
* Track pharmacy\-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

**Data Validation \& Source Reconciliation**

* Validate, reconcile, and cross\-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected\-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third\-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.
* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.
* Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.
* Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM\-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

**AI\-Assisted Detection \& Validation**

* Use AI\- and machine learning–driven detection tools to flag suspicious patterns, score risk, and surface high\-priority cases for review.
* Validate AI\-generated alerts and model outputs against source claims and clinical data, distinguishing genuine fraud indicators from false positives, data artifacts, and legitimate clinical variation.
* Provide structured feedback to analytics, vendor, and PBM partners to improve model accuracy, tuning, and rule logic over time.
* Stay current on emerging AI\-enabled fraud schemes (e.g., synthetic identities, deepfakes, generated prescriptions or prior authorization documentation, fraudulent e\-prescribing credentials) and adapt detection approaches accordingly.

**Pharmacy Fraud Detection, Triggers \& Red Flags**

* Apply deep knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and typologies — including prescribing and dispensing patterns — to proactively identify suspicious activity before it escalates.
* Develop, refine, and document indicators and detection criteria based on emerging schemes and investigative learnings.
* Investigate referrals and self\-sourced leads, building complete case referrals supported by validated evidence.

**Case Referrals**

* Conduct thorough data validation into suspected fraudulent activity, documenting methodology, findings, and conclusions.
* Maintain accurate, audit\-ready case records in the case management system.
* Prepare clear written summaries and present findings to leadership, business partners, legal, and, when appropriate, law enforcement or regulatory bodies.

**Collaboration \& Mentorship**

* Partner with claims, payment integrity, underwriting, compliance, legal, and data teams —

jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**



Join a team that’s changing financial services



Zocks is the \#1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000\+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.



We're a venture\-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.

 **WHO YOU ARE**



The SHARC in the room



At Zocks, we hire for SHARC \- five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.


**S \- Sharp**



You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution \- you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.


**H \- Hungry**



You're a self\-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.


**A \- Adaptable**



Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.


**R \- Resilient**



Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.


**C \- Curious**



You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work \- and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

 **What You'll Do**



The Account Manager is responsible for owning the full post\-sale lifecycle for a set of customers from the moment they sign through their renewal. This role blends onboarding ownership with long\-term account management. You will guide customers through setup, launch, early adoption, and ongoing success, ensuring they achieve fast time\-to\-value and remain successful and retained customers.


You will run structured onboarding for the first 60 days, then continue as the primary relationship manager responsible for adoption, sentiment, value realization, renewal readiness, and churn prevention. You will identify risks early, build multi\-threaded relationships, run health reviews, and execute a consistent renewal playbook. This is a hands\-on role for someone who loves helping customers win, shaping process, and driving measurable retention outcomes.



**Key Responsibilities**


**Customer Onboarding Ownership (First 60 Days)**


* Act as the single\-threaded owner for every new customer during onboarding.
* Run kickoff calls, define success criteria, align on use cases, and ensure a clean sales\-to\-onboarding handoff.
* Guide customers through setup, integrations, configuration, and go\-live.
* Manage timelines, remove blockers, and keep customers moving to activation.
* Teach users how to use Zocks with live trainings, walkthroughs, and simple enablement content.
* Ensure a smooth post\-onboarding transition while staying on as the ongoing account owner.

  


**Adoption and Value Realization**


* Drive user activation and usage across key product features.
* Monitor customer engagement signals including meeting volume, utilization, integration completion, and workflow setup.
* Run scheduled check\-ins to reinforce value, highlight wins, and review progress.
* Build repeatable playbooks for increasing adoption and correcting early usage gaps.
* Partner with Product and RevOps to share insights on customer needs and feature impact.


**Churn Prevention and Account Health**
* Own Gross ARR Retention and renewal outcomes for your book of business.
* Maintain clear visibility into account health using dashboards, health scores, and engagement metrics.
* Identify churn risks early and execute save plays including sentiment resets, retraining, and workflow redesign.
* Document risks and escalate where necessary with clear recommended actions.
* Ensure ongoing alignment with customer goals and continuously reinforce ROI.


**Renewal Management (120 days leading up to renewal)**
* Own renewal preparation, forecasting accuracy, and timely execution.
* Run structured renewal processes including usage reviews, performance summaries, and value recap meetings.
* Confirm contract terms, seat counts, and pricing ahead of renewal cycles.
* Manage renewal negotiations directly with customers and ensure renewal approval happens on time.
* Maintain renewal documentation in Salesforce with clean, complete data.


**Cross\-Functional Alignment**
* Partner with Sales to ensure a smooth handoff at contract signature and clarity on success outcomes.
* Work with Product on implementation feedback, customer asks, and adoption blockers.
* Collaborate with RevOps to improve onboarding and retention reporting, health scoring, and automation.
* Work with Support for escalations and ensure customers understand engagement paths after onboarding.
  


**Operational Excellence**
* Document customer configurations, onboarding progress, known risks, and adoption milestones.
* Update onboarding and renewal playbooks based on learnings and patterns from your accounts.
* Identify opportunities for automation or simplification in workflows, templates, and customer communication.
* Own accuracy and upkeep of notes, tasks, and renewal data across Salesforce and internal tools.


**What We're Looking For**
**Requirements**
* 2 to 5 plus years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Onboarding at a B2B SaaS company.
* Experience in wealth\-tech, fintech, or regulated SaaS.
* Proven success driving fast time\-to\-value and strong renewals.
* Strong communication skills and confidence leading customer\-facing calls.
* Comfortable working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and RevOps.
* High technical curiosity with willingness to learn product workflows and integrations.
* Highly organized with strong operational discipline and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts at once

jobs.description:
Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient\-centered, clinical\-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Guided by our core values, Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome, we are committed to transforming the future of treatment for autoimmune disease. Join us at the forefront of cell therapy innovation and help redefine what’s possible.


**Reports to:** VP of Sales  

**Territory:** Pacific


**Position Summary**



Kyverna is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Cell Therapy Account Management Specialist to support the launch of our innovative cell therapy approach in autoimmune disease.



The Cell Therapy Account Management Specialist will serve as the commercial account lead for designated treatment centers, academic institutions, community practices, and referral networks within an assigned geography. This individual will drive demand and execute strategic account plans designed to build awareness, facilitate appropriate patient identification and referral, support treatment\-center readiness, and drive appropriate adoption of Kyverna's cell therapy owning the performance of the assigned geography.



### **Responsibilities**


* Deliver against defined sales, account, and performance objectives while maintaining the highest standards of compliance and patient focus.
* Own the overall commercial strategy, performance, and execution for assigned treatment centers and associated referral networks.
* Develop and execute comprehensive, account\-specific business plans aligned with national and regional commercial priorities.
* Identify opportunities to increase appropriate patient identification, referral, and treatment within assigned accounts.
* Analyze account dynamics, referral patterns, patient flows, competitive activity, and market trends to identify opportunities and barriers.
* Develop deep knowledge of the autoimmune treatment landscape, cell therapy, and Kyverna's clinical and commercial value proposition.
* Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across neurology, Hem/Onc cell therapy experts, and other relevant specialties involved in the diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune disease.
* Navigate complex academic medical centers, integrated delivery networks, community practices, and referral networks.
* Understand stakeholder needs and identify opportunities to address barriers to appropriate patient identification, referral, access, and treatment.
* Serve as a knowledgeable and responsive commercial resource for assigned accounts.
* Identify and map patient referral pathways across autoimmune disease networks.
* Partner with internal cross\-functional teams to identify and address barriers across the patient journey.

* Help establish effective relationships and processes between referring physicians and authorized treatment centers.
* Partner with treatment centers to support readiness for cell therapy, including understanding patient referral, treatment, scheduling, and coordination processes.
* Develop a deep understanding of the end\-to\-end cell therapy patient journey and use that knowledge to improve patient experience.

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the evolving autoimmune disease and cell therapy landscape.

* Execute all activities in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, company policies, and industry standards.
* Maintain accurate account plans, customer information, activity documentation, and business intelligence.

* Demonstrated success managing large, complex healthcare accounts with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Experience working with academic medical centers, community practices, integrated delivery networks, or other complex healthcare systems.
